description: Single-panel high-resolution XPS spectrum labelled "(a₁)" — an Mn 2p photoelectron spectrum with a reversed binding-energy axis running from 652 eV (left) to 634 eV (right), ticked every 2 eV, labelled "Binding energy (eV)"; the y-axis is labelled "Intensity (a.u.)" and carries no numeric scale. The noisy black envelope is the measured data, over which a red curve shows the overall fit; this fit is deconvoluted into shaded component peaks: a pink/red component whose maximum lies in the ~645–642 eV region annotated "Mn⁴⁺", a violet component at slightly lower binding energy annotated "Mn²⁺", and a smaller green component on the high-binding-energy shoulder annotated "Mn²⁺sat". Arrows connect each printed label to its component. The pink and violet components overlap strongly and jointly form the main Mn 2p₃/₂ envelope between roughly 648 and 640 eV. No numeric peak positions, areas or percentages are printed, and the scan is truncated at the low-energy side, so the 2p₁/₂ spin–orbit partner is not shown. The panel demonstrates that the Mn 2p₃/₂ signal requires at least three fitted components (Mn⁴⁺, Mn²⁺ and a Mn²⁺ satellite), implying a mixed-valence Mn state in the oxide film; the "(a₁)" label indicates the first member of a series of such spectra.

subfigures.description: High-resolution Mn 2p XPS spectrum plotted as Intensity (a.u.) versus Binding energy (eV), axis reversed from 652 to 634 eV with 2 eV ticks. A black raw-data trace is fitted by a red envelope that is decomposed into three shaded components: pink (labelled Mn⁴⁺), violet (labelled Mn²⁺) and green on the high-binding-energy shoulder (labelled Mn²⁺sat). Arrows link each label to its peak; no numeric positions, areas or percentages are printed.

observations.observation: The figure is a single high-resolution XPS spectrum whose x-axis is labelled "Binding energy (eV)" and runs in reverse from 652 on the left to 634 on the right, with major ticks every 2 eV.
The y-axis is labelled "Intensity (a.u.)" and shows no numeric tick values.
A noisy black measured trace is overlaid by a red fitted envelope that spans the whole displayed range, and the total fit is decomposed into three shaded component peaks (pink, violet, green).
An arrow from the label "Mn⁴⁺" points to the pink fitted component, whose maximum lies in the middle of the plotted range (between the 646 and 642 eV ticks).
An arrow from the label "Mn²⁺" points to the violet fitted component, which is located at lower binding energy than the Mn⁴⁺ component (further to the right, near the 642–641 eV ticks).
An arrow from the label "Mn²⁺sat" points to a small green component sitting on the high-binding-energy shoulder of the Mn 2p₃/₂ envelope (around the 646–645 eV region).
The pink and violet components overlap heavily and together account for the bulk of the main peak intensity, forming one composite band between roughly 648 and 640 eV.
No numeric peak positions, component areas, atomic percentages or fitting residuals are printed anywhere on the panel.
The spectrum is cut off at the low-binding-energy end; only the Mn 2p₃/₂ region is shown and no 2p₁/₂ spin–orbit partner is displayed.
The panel is labelled "(a₁)" in the top-left corner, indicating it is the first member of a series of comparable spectra rather than a stand-alone measurement.
